requirement:
修复前端调用订票和支付相关 API 的 bug。
用户在订票流程中选择座位和支付时接口返回异常。
需要检查订票服务的座位调用和支付安全验证逻辑。

details.name: ts-payment-service
details.rationale: Payment security validation is mentioned in the requirement, and ts-payment-service handles payment processing and likely interacts with ts-preserve-other-service.

details.name: ts-seat-service
details.rationale: Seat selection is part of the booking flow and ts-preserve-other-service likely calls this service for seat availability and assignment.

details.name: ts-inside-payment-service
details.rationale: This service handles internal payment operations and may be called by ts-preserve-other-service during the payment flow.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order creation is part of the booking flow, and ts-preserve-other-service may interact with ts-order-service to create or update orders.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Similar to ts-order-service, this service handles other order types and may be involved in the booking flow.

details.name: ts-preserve-service
details.rationale: This service handles the main preserve (booking) flow and may share logic or be called by ts-preserve-other-service.

details.name: ts-travel-service
details.rationale: Travel information is needed for booking, and ts-preserve-other-service may call ts-travel-service for trip details.

details.name: ts-travel2-service
details.rationale: Alternative travel service that may be used for booking or seat selection.

details.name: ts-route-service
details.rationale: Route information may be required for seat selection and booking, and ts-preserve-other-service could depend on it.

details.name: ts-route-plan-service
details.rationale: Route planning may be involved in the booking flow, potentially called by ts-preserve-other-service.

details.name: ts-security-service
details.rationale: Security validation logic may be centralized here, and ts-preserve-other-service might interact with it for payment security.

details.name: ts-train-service
details.rationale: Train information is needed for seat selection, and ts-preserve-other-service may query this service.

details.name: ts-auth-service
details.rationale: Payment security validation may involve authentication or authorization checks, and ts-preserve-other-service could call ts-auth-service.

details.name: ts-gateway-service
details.rationale: The gateway routes API calls and may need changes if the bug is related to API routing or request handling.
